The Office editor is built from ranuts/document v0.0.6, pinned by
vendor/fetch-ranuts-document.sh. It includes the AGPL-3.0 OnlyOffice WASM
editor. When distributing the editor, provide its corresponding source
and retain its ONLYOFFICE attribution.

https://github.com/ranuts/document/tree/82cb9f68617383c1b3a00865a5880069cbdf2d92
